description:
Record a connection between two files you can read, possibly in different workspaces (e.g. an old
        project's solution and a new project's requirement). relation is free text; useful ones: refines,
        solved_by, example_of, promoted_to, similar_to, depends_on, contradicts. note = your reasoning.
        Leave versions empty to link whole files.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

from_path.description: The file the link starts from.
from_path.title: From Path

from_version.description: Link a specific version of the from-file. Omit for the whole file.
from_version.title: From Version

from_workspace_id.description: The workspace of the file the link starts from.
from_workspace_id.title: From Workspace Id

note.description: Your reasoning for the link. Optional.
note.title: Note

relation.description: How they're connected, free text, e.g. solved_by, refines, example_of, similar_to.
relation.title: Relation

to_path.description: The file the link points to.
to_path.title: To Path

to_version.description: Link a specific version of the to-file. Omit for the whole file.
to_version.title: To Version

to_workspace_id.description: The workspace of the file the link points to.
to_workspace_id.title: To Workspace Id

name: link_files
